references.text: Jesus also speaks here about the unforgivable sin, which is blasphemy against the Holy Spirit.
Jesus warns again about blasphemy against the Holy Spirit as an unforgivable sin.
This passage discusses the impossibility of renewing to repentance those who have fallen away, which can be seen in connection with the unforgivable sin.
James emphasizes that breaking one commandment is like breaking them all, which can be related to the seriousness of blasphemy against the Holy Spirit.
